numbers.label: Lukoil Perm refinery hit by drones
Confirmed dead in Banten factory fire
Teams set for 2031 Women's World Cup
Women in NHS EDITH AI cancer trial
NZ Day 5 stand to draw India Test

heroes.headline: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO; stock surges 31.3%
heroes.summary: Board votes unanimously 11 days after exit following US security talks; NVDA hits $164.88, S&P 500 jumps 4.73% (7,237) and Nasdaq +6.5%.

heroes.headline: Ukraine hits Perm refinery & sinks Russian corvette off Libya
heroes.summary: Drones strike Lukoil's Perm plant (>1,500 km deep) and Novoshakhtinsk; SBU & Zelenskyy confirm naval drones sank Merkury & hit MV Angara.

heroes.headline: Drones strike Khartoum UN compound; famine chokepoint warned
heroes.summary: RSF-blamed strikes wound UN staff; Sudan alleges Ethiopian launch (Addis denies). WFP warns UNSC of acute famine risk in Sudan & Somalia.

features.headline: Supreme Court grants amnesty to Puigdemont
features.summary: Ends 2017 Catalan case, clearing last legal bar to return after ~9 years in exile.

features.headline: General strike shuts Belgian air traffic control
features.summary: skeyes halts flights 07:00–21:00; Brussels Airport cancels departures in budget row.

features.headline: Fighting erupts near Ituri Ebola hospital
features.summary: Medics shelter in maternity ward as WHO pleads for peace in outbreak epicentre.

features.headline: Kospi drops 3.3%; Taiwan bans short sales
features.summary: Kospi falls up to 5.8% before US rally; Taiwan enforces uptick ban & 150% margin.

features.headline: FIFA ratifies 2031 & 2035 Women's World Cups
features.summary: US, Mexico, Costa Rica & Jamaica host 48-team 2031; UK gets first Cup since 1966.

features.headline: Tajikistan notifies UN of ICC withdrawal
features.summary: Rome Statute exit takes effect Nov 2027 after Putin visit row; ICC & EU voice regret.

features.headline: Mass bomb threats hit Danish & German schools
features.summary: Hundreds of schools receive 'Death awaits you' emails; police rule hybrid hoax.

features.headline: NZ bat out Day 5 to draw 1st Test vs India
features.summary: Mitchell (49*) & Phillips (26*) hold out for 239-5 off 120 overs in Wellington.

features.headline: Banten sweet-factory fire toll rises to 24
features.summary: Identification continues at PT Fonusa Agung Mulia in Cikande; dozens unaccounted for.

features.headline: Eisenkot rules out near-term Iran strike as talks fail
features.summary: Designated PM condemns West Bank arson as 'Jewish terrorism' after Likud talks collapse.

briefs.text: NHS launches £10m EDITH trial: world's largest AI breast-cancer study (700k women).
Merz, Zelenskyy & ~30 allied leaders urge Russia to accept winter energy ceasefire.
Russian strikes kill at least 15 as Ukraine presses allies for winter air defences.
12,000+ evacuated, 80+ treated after suspected tear gas at Don Toliver show.
Greek police arrest 5 Macedonians over alleged Iran-backed plot on Israeli exec.
BSI raises national IT threat to critical over autonomous agentic AI attacks.
Russia warns Estonia & calls Ukraine's Libya naval drone strikes a 'dangerous trend'.
Haaretz reports 23 soldier & police suicides in 2026 — highest toll in 16 years.
US issues fresh Iran-linked sanctions; Iran vows 'all available means' vs blockade.
Qatar PM warns Middle East cannot withstand a renewed US–Iran escalation.
Turkish intelligence says PKK evacuated 14 more Hakurk bases in peace process.
UAE condemns Somalia's 72-hour envoy expulsion as 'hostile and unjustified'.
World Chess Championship opens: Gukesh (20) vs Sindarov (20), youngest match ever.
Rescue underway after boat carrying ~100 migrants capsizes off coast.
President Tinubu urges parliament to decriminalise attempted suicide.
Sharara oil pipeline reopens, easing crude; east Libya seizes 4M+ drug pills.
Palace unveils 4bn-dirham plan to make 40% of defence gear locally by 2035.
5th Africa Public Health Conference opens; German Pres. begins Abidjan tour.
CREA cites $21.6bn oil windfall for 9 African exporters; Durban hosts water talks.
Lowy 2026 Asia Power Index keeps India #3, tightest China gap since 2018.
Government weighs up to 30% non-Basmati rice export duty from Dec on inflation.
Reports say China's 4th, nuclear-powered aircraft carrier nears completion.
Police fire tear gas at garment wage protesters; ADB adds 5 solar projects.
Authorities restrict memorials before 1st anniversary of Tai Po fire (168 dead).
Archaeologists report centuries-old hidden tunnel network under Hagia Sophia.
DoJ admits US mistakenly deported Texas citizen Brian Morales García to Mexico.
Trump says he will defer to 8th Circuit on Army's 60-barrel explosives blast.
Protests at Sea-Tac after masked ICE agents arrest father & daughter on jetway.
ICE detains Princeton neuroscience researcher at Reagan National Airport.
Coastal storms, El Niño warmth & 20-yr king tides threaten holiday flooding.
US EDA awards $39m disaster infrastructure aid; NC unveils Helene airport grants.
Save the Children warns of malaria spike threatening kids in M7.4 quake zone.
Argentina midfielder Leandro Paredes briefly collapses during post-match TV chat.
South American body leans toward US hosting 2028 Copa América in WC venues.
Music legend & Countdown host Ian 'Molly' Meldrum dies aged 83; state funeral set.
Australia flash services PMI falls to 46.2 (5-yr low); NZ joins NATO air pact.
Bitcoin rebounds near $62k & gold tops $3,615/oz while Brent eases to $88–91.
